{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count total rows
total_rows = len(df)
print(f'total_rows = {total_rows}')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
duplicates_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'duplicates_count = {duplicates_count}')

# Deduplicate: keep row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Final unique patient count
unique_patients_count = len(df_dedup)
print(f'unique_patients_count = {unique_patients_count}')"}
